review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form; R15 is complete and materially stronger, but it does not establish an Econometrica-level incremental contribution from the learned Bellman critic. A substantially shorter verification-centered new submission, or a prospective NBO study with stronger baselines, could merit review.
blocking_findings: The learned Bellman critic has no demonstrated incremental economic value relative to the cheaper Raw alternative.
The positive neural-HJB comparison is specific to one difficult and insufficiently validated implementation.
The dimension-10 material-superiority sign is a post-freeze analytical reanalysis and needs prospective replication.
The sixteen-stream finite distribution and pilot-selected high-volatility calibration have narrow external scope.
The high-dimensional result is conservative safe improvement rather than an accurate HJB solution.
The work comparison does not identify an NBO efficiency advantage because Raw is cheaper and unresolved in payoff.
The operational mechanism account closes procedurally but is too imprecise to support a causal critic narrative.
The cumulative manuscript remains too broad and long relative to the capital-specific result.
positive_findings: R15 is a complete, immutable, source-bound publication snapshot.
The prospective four-method experiment executes all 128 declared runs and retains failures.
Method-level estimands, common-path direct contrasts, and familywise inference are explicit.
The paired-policy continuous-time transfer is a potentially useful method-agnostic contribution.
The candidate-occupation mechanism account is operational and reports unfavorable outcomes honestly.
Complete clocks, operation counters, scalar classical evidence, and observation sensitivity are retained.
Provenance, preservation, and compilation records are unusually strong.

limitations: The reviewer did not rerun all 128 time- and environment-dependent training jobs.
The reviewer checked nine exact committed publication tables and one original dimension-50 raw artifact.
The reviewer found no immediate contradiction in the new Bellman-bridge and paired-transfer statements but did not formally verify every proof constant or interval kernel.
An inconclusive NBO-minus-Raw/DPO interval is not treated as equality or practical equivalence.
The post-freeze paired-transfer refinement is not called invalid; it is classified as analytical reanalysis requiring prospective replication.
This advisory report is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
